nodes.rationale: CLI sessions do not inherit Test fixtures or the network guard, so restrict them to the isolated public sign-in surface; never production, personal profiles or PHI; MCP stays optional and unconfigured.

nodes.label: Playwright 1.62.1 lockstep pin (@playwright/test, playwright, playwright-core; Node >= 20; jsdom 26.1.0)
nodes.norm_label: playwright 1.62.1 lockstep pin (@playwright/test, playwright, playwright-core; node >= 20; jsdom 26.1.0)
nodes.rationale: Never initialize another Playwright project or upgrade one package without the other two; the executable selected by the installed version must exist for the platform, and unrelated revisions must not be symlinked.

nodes.label: syntheticReports opt-in fixture option (V2-03)
nodes.rationale: An exact allowlist of lab_reports, biomarkers, report_analytes and interpretations reads plus prior-report history handlers from V2-03 amendment 2; two or more reports must be wrapped as [[a, b], { scope: 'test' }] because Playwright reads a bare pair as a [value, options] tuple; rows are invented values, never patient data.

nodes.label: Turn-6 correction: envDir false did not stop .env loading (Vite 5.4.8 falls back to the project root)
nodes.norm_label: turn-6 correction: envdir false did not stop .env loading (vite 5.4.8 falls back to the project root)
nodes.rationale: The Lead proved it with synthetic VITE_APP_URL and VITE_FREEMIUM_ACTIVE canaries in served modules; earlier green smoke runs did not prove isolation.

nodes.label: Consumable purchase grants indefinite Plus hazard (NON_RENEWING_PURCHASE mapped to active)
nodes.norm_label: consumable purchase grants indefinite plus hazard (non_renewing_purchase mapped to active)
nodes.rationale: Safety-critical finding read from main, not tested: an active production IAP row with a null expires_at is entitled indefinitely, and web one-time Stripe payments land in stripe_orders, which entitlement.ts never reads. Must be fixed before any non-subscription product exists in any store.

nodes.label: Option B: Per-report deep unlock (one-time purchase per draw)
nodes.norm_label: option b: per-report deep unlock (one-time purchase per draw)

nodes.label: RevenueCat premium entitlement and default offering
nodes.norm_label: revenuecat premium entitlement and default offering

nodes.label: Account Deletion Paths (in-app Delete My Data and /delete-account URL)
nodes.norm_label: account deletion paths (in-app delete my data and /delete-account url)
nodes.rationale: Play requires both an in-app deletion path and a web URL; the public page also explains the store-subscription caveat and email help for users who cannot sign in.

nodes.label: Android App Links (assetlinks.json with Play App Signing SHA-256)
nodes.norm_label: android app links (assetlinks.json with play app signing sha-256)
nodes.rationale: Uses the Play App Signing fingerprint rather than the upload key; the local JSON does not prove domain association, which must be verified with a password-recovery App Link on the Play-installed build.

nodes.label: Data Safety: Collected Data Types
nodes.rationale: All data is linked to identity because every table is keyed on auth.users.id under row-level security, except Sentry crash logs; parser_debug is written only in dev builds, so diagnostics are not declared, and uploaded lab images carrying legal name and DOB are sent to OpenAI.

nodes.label: iap_beta_testers Sandbox Allowlist
nodes.rationale: Migration 20260903120000_add_iap_beta_testers.sql must be pushed and the IAP functions redeployed; one row per licence tester keyed on auth.users.id, with no UI and no env var by design.

nodes.label: Mobile 1.0.5 Release Candidate (Android versionCode 10, iOS build 9)
nodes.norm_label: mobile 1.0.5 release candidate (android versioncode 10, ios build 9)
nodes.rationale: The Lead builds both native candidates from the merge commit; the September 4 claim that the IAP functions were undeployed is stale, so purchase/restore and webhook delivery are confirmed in release QA rather than asserted from source.

nodes.label: Native Email/Password-Only Login (social buttons hidden)
nodes.rationale: Native login and signup hide both social-login buttons; web keeps Google and enables Apple only when VITE_ENABLE_APPLE_OAUTH=true, so Play review credentials must be email/password.

nodes.label: Owner Decision Register (18 Play submission decisions)
nodes.norm_label: owner decision register (18 play submission decisions)

nodes.label: Unhandled Play ':basePlanId' Product Identifier Suffix
nodes.rationale: RevenueCat identifies Play products as subscriptionId:basePlanId, so bare-id comparisons can empty the Android paywall (toStoreProduct), deny sandbox beta entitlement and malform the manage-subscription link; iOS and production Play receipts are unaffected. Fix in a separate PR by normalising the part before ':' while keeping the raw product_id for audit, and verify on a real device first.

nodes.label: Play Console URLs (privacy, terms, delete-account, support)
nodes.norm_label: play console urls (privacy, terms, delete-account, support)

nodes.label: Release Notes and Tester Instructions (1.0.4 internal beta)
nodes.norm_label: release notes and tester instructions (1.0.4 internal beta)
nodes.rationale: The purchase step is left out until verify-iap-purchase and iap-webhook are deployed and the tester has an iap_beta_testers row; without the row a sandbox purchase correctly entitles nobody once the trial lapses.

nodes.label: RevenueCat Store Subscription Processor (appUserID = auth user id)
nodes.norm_label: revenuecat store subscription processor (appuserid = auth user id)

nodes.label: Play Review Access Instructions (demo credentials, SubscriptionGate on /app/new)
nodes.norm_label: play review access instructions (demo credentials, subscriptiongate on /app/new)
nodes.rationale: Amani is entirely behind a login; /app/new is the only route behind SubscriptionGate and a fresh account is inside its 7-day trial, so a reviewer can walk the whole product without paying; a sample lab PDF is worth more than the credentials.

nodes.label: Sentry Crash Reporting (unlinked, console breadcrumbs off)
nodes.norm_label: sentry crash reporting (unlinked, console breadcrumbs off)
nodes.rationale: Active only when VITE_SENTRY_DSN is set; sendDefaultPii is false and Sentry.setUser is never called, so crash logs are declared not linked; console breadcrumbs are disabled because the parser logs lab text, while DOM and navigation breadcrumbs remain.

nodes.label: Amani Plus Subscription Product IDs (premium.monthly / premium.yearly)
nodes.norm_label: amani plus subscription product ids (premium.monthly / premium.yearly)
nodes.rationale: IDs must match App Store Connect and Play Console exactly and are permanent (Apple never reuses a deleted product ID), so a change is a new product, not a rename; the client and edge-function lists are kept in sync by tests because edge functions cannot import from src/.

nodes.label: 'Under 18' Onboarding Age Option vs 18+ Terms
nodes.rationale: Declaring an 18+ target audience while AGE_RANGES invites under-18s to identify themselves is the mismatch Play's families policy notices; remove the option or be ready to explain it.

nodes.label: Google Play Console Submission Material
nodes.rationale: Copy-paste source for the Play Console App content and Store listing forms, derived from repository code; anything the code cannot answer is marked DECISION, and nothing has been submitted to Play.

nodes.label: IAP_SETUP.md (App Store Connect, Play Console, RevenueCat setup)
nodes.norm_label: iap_setup.md (app store connect, play console, revenuecat setup)
nodes.rationale: The code (src/lib/iap-config.ts) is the source of truth for identifiers and this doc for the consoles; the consoles are configured in order because RevenueCat cannot read products that do not exist and the app cannot fetch offerings RevenueCat has not been given.

nodes.label: Amani-Granted 7-Day Trial (no Play free-trial offer)
nodes.rationale: The trial comes from users.trial_start_date and TRIAL_DURATION_MS, not from Play; a Play free-trial offer would stack on it and give Android users 14 days, so base plans stay offer-free and the listing's trial wording is an owner DECISION.

nodes.label: Android 15+ Edge-to-Edge via Capacitor SystemBars
nodes.rationale: statusBarColor/windowLightStatusBar theme settings are kept for API 24-34; on Android 15+ Capacitor 8.5.1 SystemBars (insetsHandling=css, viewport-fit=cover) supplies safe-area insets to CSS, so obscured edges are fixed with the .safe-* utilities, not in MainActivity, and no edge-to-edge opt-out is added. The Play warning is informational until Android 15/16 device QA.

nodes.label: Data Safety Judgment Calls (profile fields, App interactions, location, UGC)
nodes.norm_label: data safety judgment calls (profile fields, app interactions, location, ugc)
nodes.rationale: Split profile fields between Other info and Health info (or put all under Health info, consistently with the privacy policy); declare App interactions because Sentry breadcrumbs leave the device and under-declaring is the expensive mistake with Play; do not declare approximate location for RevenueCat's store country; fold free-text notes into Health info.

nodes.label: Data Safety: No Data Shared (service-provider carve-out)
nodes.norm_label: data safety: no data shared (service-provider carve-out)
nodes.rationale: Every third party (Supabase, OpenAI, Stripe, Apple/Google, RevenueCat, Sentry, Netlify) acts as a processor on Amani's behalf; the carve-out is a legal judgment not yet confirmed by a lawyer, and a disagreement would change the answer and force resubmission.

nodes.label: Play Catalog Ordering (upload signed AAB before creating subscriptions)
nodes.norm_label: play catalog ordering (upload signed aab before creating subscriptions)
nodes.rationale: Play serves no products to a package it has never seen, so getIapOfferings returns nothing until a signed AAB is on a testing track; creating subscriptions first looks like a broken app.

nodes.label: Premium vs Plus Naming Inconsistency
nodes.rationale: Use 'Amani Plus' only in Play display strings; product IDs and the RevenueCat 'premium' entitlement are permanent, and renaming them would burn Apple products, create new Play products, migrate the entitlement and touch code and five test files for a string no user sees.

nodes.label: Privacy Policy Draft Banner and Pending Legal Review
nodes.norm_label: privacy policy draft banner and pending legal review
nodes.rationale: Privacy.tsx opens with a draft, not-reviewed-by-a-lawyer banner and flags Washington My Health My Data, Nevada SB 370 and GDPR obligations as unaddressed; keeping the banner is honest and it must not be removed while it is still true.

nodes.label: US-Only Closed Beta Country Targeting
nodes.rationale: Parser adapters and reference ranges target US labs and conventional units; GDPR special-category obligations are unaddressed; EU MDR, UK MDR and TGA rules make the not-a-device position harder to hold; US state health-privacy exposure already exists. Internal testing ignores country, but unset non-US prices leave an empty paywall.

nodes.label: append_interpretation_version writer
nodes.rationale: Service-only SECURITY DEFINER writer: 22023 for a NULL request, non-deep depth or non-object provenance; 23503 for a missing or foreign report or no anchor (first generation is never a version); expected-current from the committed parent or the pointer; reads or writes no claim, regeneration_count, subscription or entitlement state.

nodes.label: readAnchor (formerly hasAnchor)
nodes.rationale: The same owner-bound read_interpretation_for_server call, now also returning has_claim (claimCovered), the readers' shared claim derivation.

nodes.label: interpretation_has_current_claims classifier
nodes.rationale: A necessary structural authority check, not proof that model generation and clinical-language validation ran.

nodes.label: append_interpretation_version_internal primitive
nodes.rationale: Dormant append primitive with no grant to service_role; moves the pointer in the same statement as the append, raises 40001 on a stale expected-current version, and never rewinds the pointer on a retried request.

nodes.label: interpretation_current_versions pointer
nodes.rationale: One explicit pointer per report to a version of that report; selection is never MAX(generated_at).

nodes.label: interpretation_version_current_claims CHECK
nodes.rationale: Named so a mutation can target it; a structural claims check that is not evidence V2-03b/03c processing ran.

nodes.label: interpretation_versions table
nodes.rationale: Append-only versions with composite report/parent/history FKs, request_id, own generated_at (clock_timestamp) and policy_provenance; never presented under the historical id or time.

nodes.label: interpretation-versions.authority.sql single-layer authority controls
nodes.rationale: Accepts 22023 from the append check or 23514 from the table CHECK; AUTHORITY-CHECK-ONLY and AUTHORITY-FUNCTION-ONLY survive, AUTHORITY-BOTH kills.

nodes.label: 20261011000000_legacy_remediation_eligibility.sql
nodes.rationale: One-shot wrapper migration that refuses replay and refuses to apply without the version foundation; writes no rows.

nodes.label: append_remediation_version wrapper
nodes.rationale: Only service entry to the version store: locks the report, re-evaluates eligibility (P0490 when ineligible), takes the parent from an already-committed request or else the current pointer, then calls the primitive; it must not set the pointer itself or an old retry would rewind the selection.

nodes.label: interpretation_read_quarantine
nodes.rationale: The unchanged quarantine sequence now also binds on the selected version body, with interpretation_sanitize_basic applied to non-covered Basic.

nodes.label: interpretation-versions.read.sql and read fixtures (harness section 10)
nodes.rationale: Fixtures rA-rF cover selection of a second version, version without pointer, never remediated, current-policy, draw-only claim and foreign user; two states are built administratively by writing the pointer table directly.

nodes.label: read_compatible_interpretations / interpretations view
nodes.rationale: Backs the flag-off client view with the same selection; body, generated_at, disclaimer_version and source come from the selected version while id and tier stay the historical row's. Keeps its columns, so CREATE OR REPLACE preserves the view dependency.

nodes.label: read_interpretation_for_server
nodes.rationale: A LATERAL selection yields one row per owned report where the pointed version wins and supplies every body, source and depth field; adds historical_interpretation_id, selected_version_id and selected_generated_at. Uses DROP + CREATE because CREATE OR REPLACE cannot change the return type (42P13).

nodes.label: readSelected
nodes.rationale: Accepts the three optional identity fields; a partial identity, or a version id equal to the historical id, fails closed with 503 entitlement_unavailable so a body is never served under the wrong identity.

nodes.label: Owner Ruling 2 (reader identity and served tier)
nodes.norm_label: owner ruling 2 (reader identity and served tier)
nodes.rationale: View id = COALESCE(selected version id, historical id) and tier = plus when a version is selected, because a version is always a deep current-policy AI body; Full vs Basic is still decided by claim or subscription, never by tier or a version existing.

nodes.label: READ-* reader killing mutations
nodes.rationale: READ-HISTORY-FIRST, READ-MAX-GENERATED, READ-UNION, READ-IDENTITY-SWAP, READ-SKIP-QUARANTINE, READ-BASIC-FROM-HISTORY and READ-CROSS-USER for RPC and view; dropping the redundant historical join is a declared equivalent mutant.

nodes.label: View id and tier identity tension
nodes.norm_label: view id and tier identity tension
nodes.rationale: The view id stays the historical anchor beside the version body, in tension with design 3.6, and tier stays historical so a remediated report with historical tier free still shows the upgrade offer; held for Lead/owner.

nodes.label: TASK-048 Turn 8: Reader Cutover to the Explicitly Selected Version
nodes.norm_label: task-048 turn 8: reader cutover to the explicitly selected version
nodes.rationale: Before this turn a remediated report still rendered quarantined because both readers selected only interpretations_private; implements design section 3 for both customer readers and the edge read policy. No SQL was executed.

nodes.label: Append-only interpretation version store (design)
nodes.rationale: Service-only versions with own UUID, composite FKs binding history, parent and report, success-only appends, an explicit current-selection pointer, request-identity idempotency and expected-current concurrency control; a version is storage evidence only and grants nothing.

nodes.label: Current-selection and read contract
nodes.rationale: Bind the user to the report first, take every field from one explicitly selected version, reapply claim-authority, safety and entitlement projection, fall back to quarantined history, and expose historical and version identities separately.

nodes.label: Generated Database type gaps and narrow users overlay
nodes.norm_label: generated database type gaps and narrow users overlay
nodes.rationale: Nine tables are absent from generated Tables, the version graph is held as typed StoredVersion threads, and the generated users row omits onboarding/profile fields and wrongly makes trial_start_date non-null; exceptions are explicit, not casts inventing generated columns.

nodes.label: Owner Ruling 9 activation record (2026-10-16)
nodes.rationale: Source for visibility and the client flag being true; observed post-limit generation 4 succeeded with source ai and read access basic on plan free; Lead-supplied, not re-read, and a later contradiction needs owner resolution.

nodes.label: Production configuration pin (Freemium active, post-limit generation unset)
nodes.norm_label: production configuration pin (freemium active, post-limit generation unset)
nodes.rationale: Pins VITE_FREEMIUM_ACTIVE=true, FREEMIUM_ACTIVE=true, visibility on, FREEMIUM_POST_LIMIT_GENERATION unset (module default always) and the launch seed with null version keys and features {}, matching the 2026-10-17 production read and secret-name listing supplied in TASK-053; no secret values recorded.

nodes.label: Abuse limits (300 events/user/day, 20 attribution calls, 60 per hashed IP, 20,000 global, 1,024-byte props)
nodes.norm_label: abuse limits (300 events/user/day, 20 attribution calls, 60 per hashed ip, 20,000 global, 1,024-byte props)
nodes.rationale: Chosen by the factory, not by owner rulings, and freely tunable.

nodes.label: app_events table (one row per funnel step)
nodes.norm_label: app_events table (one row per funnel step)

nodes.label: First-touch attribution (utm_*, promo, ref kept 90 days)
nodes.norm_label: first-touch attribution (utm_*, promo, ref kept 90 days)
nodes.rationale: A later campaign does not overwrite it, invalid values are dropped and storage that throws is tolerated.

nodes.label: funnel_daily view (events and actors per UTC day, event, utm_source)
nodes.norm_label: funnel_daily view (events and actors per utc day, event, utm_source)
nodes.rationale: Readable by service_role only, and by Jarvis through jarvis_metrics.funnel_daily.

nodes.label: Owner-GO deploy sequence for first-party events
nodes.norm_label: owner-go deploy sequence for first-party events
nodes.rationale: db push of the one-shot migration, set ANON_EVENT_IP_SALT_SECRET and deploy log-anon-event, redeploy the four server-event functions, run the privilege and ENABLE ALWAYS verification SQL, optionally grant Jarvis, then turn the flag on; each step needs owner GO.

nodes.label: Server-only events (interpretation_generated, trial_started, subscription_activated, account_deleted)
nodes.rationale: A client can never log a server event, so nobody can claim a trial or a subscription; account_deleted is written with no user id.

nodes.label: Signup promo or referral code field (D17; never promises a discount, D29)
nodes.norm_label: signup promo or referral code field (d17; never promises a discount, d29)
nodes.rationale: A valid code is held 24 hours so it survives the OAuth redirect, and the page says Code saved: KEY.

nodes.label: Signup completion attribution (24-hour window, email and OAuth)
nodes.norm_label: signup completion attribution (24-hour window, email and oauth)

nodes.label: user_attribution table (one first-touch row per user)
nodes.norm_label: user_attribution table (one first-touch row per user)

nodes.label: First-party events and signup attribution (PK-EXP5)
nodes.rationale: Amani's own EXP-5 funnel measurement with no third-party tracker, pixel or fingerprinting, under owner decisions D5.3, D6.1, D6.2, D17 and D29 and engineering decision R12; nothing is live until the owner's deploy GO.

nodes.label: features.first_party_events flag (off by default)
nodes.rationale: Off means nothing is stored on the device, nothing is sent and the signup code field is hidden; merging publishes the client through Netlify immediately while the backend waits for the owner's deploy GO; every call fails silently after 3 seconds without blocking the UX.

nodes.label: mayBeUndeployed deploy-order safety (PGRST205/42P01 treated as nothing to erase)
nodes.norm_label: maybeundeployed deploy-order safety (pgrst205/42p01 treated as nothing to erase)
nodes.rationale: PR #93's runbook can deploy delete-user-data from main before 20261015010000 is applied; a table that does not exist cannot hold rows, while any other error, or a missing table not so marked, still fails the deletion.

nodes.label: R12: indexes now, nightly funnel_daily rollup later
nodes.norm_label: r12: indexes now, nightly funnel_daily rollup later
nodes.rationale: app_events (event, created_at) and (user_id, created_at) indexes exist from day one; past about 1 million rows a scheduled job aggregates yesterday into funnel_daily_rollup and the view unions it with today's live rows.

nodes.label: Service-role-only, append-only event tables
nodes.rationale: RLS is on with no policy so no client can select or insert; the server stamps created_at and captured_at, and ENABLE ALWAYS triggers refuse UPDATE even under session_replication_role = replica.

nodes.label: Single-source event allow-lists mirrored in SQL
nodes.norm_label: single-source event allow-lists mirrored in sql
nodes.rationale: The client and edge functions import app-events-policy.ts; the migration's app_events_allowed_events(), app_events_client_events(), app_events_anon_events(), app_events_allowed_prop_keys() and user_attribution_keys() carry the same lists, and app-events-policy.test.ts fails when they differ.

nodes.label: Token-only props: never a health value, lab data or free text
nodes.norm_label: token-only props: never a health value, lab data or free text
nodes.rationale: Every prop value is a [A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64} token or a report_index 0..10000, and unknown events and keys are rejected rather than stripped.

nodes.label: Report blood-draw date anchor
nodes.rationale: As-of date used for the context snapshot, cycle day and phase, age, symptom windows, intervention alignment and series ordering.

nodes.label: lab_reports.context legacy values
nodes.rationale: Legacy birth_control, pregnant and postpartum context mapped into the new model without destroying the original.

nodes.label: Per-report female context snapshot
nodes.rationale: Server-written (clients cannot write it, proven by a grant test) and bound to each report as of the blood-draw date so later profile edits do not rewrite history.

nodes.label: Clinical analyte catalog
nodes.rationale: Existing (done) catalog supplying known units, catalog ranges and approved conversion factors.

nodes.label: AmaniContext
nodes.rationale: Versioned Zod schema in _shared, mirrored client-side where needed, built by a pure builder; every field carries a source and an as-of date.

nodes.label: V2-04-06 Postpartum state, months postpartum, breastfeeding
nodes.norm_label: v2-04-06 postpartum state, months postpartum, breastfeeding
nodes.rationale: Postpartum-specific statements need approved sources; implausible breastfeeding/stage combinations warn rather than block.

nodes.label: V2-04-07 Contraception type and HRT status
nodes.norm_label: v2-04-07 contraception type and hrt status
nodes.rationale: Medication-adjacent, so it stays explanatory; any banned-pattern change goes only in _shared/nutrient-policy.ts (or a sibling policy module) with tests.

nodes.label: V2-04-08 Fertility goal (opt-in)
nodes.rationale: Fertility assumptions must not be forced on users: with no goal set no fertility framing appears in prompts or UI. Sensitive data.

nodes.label: V2-04-10 Per-report context snapshot and legacy context mapping
nodes.norm_label: v2-04-10 per-report context snapshot and legacy context mapping
nodes.rationale: History integrity, the same principle as append-only interpretation versions: later profile edits must not rewrite a report's context, and the backfill is additive, idempotent and preserves the original.

nodes.label: V2-05-03 Unit-sanity validation
nodes.rationale: Wrong-unit interpretation is a real harm path: mismatches block interpretation of that analyte and conversions happen only with a catalog-approved factor.

nodes.label: V2-06-01 AmaniContext type, schema and builder
nodes.norm_label: v2-06-01 amanicontext type, schema and builder
nodes.rationale: Becomes the contract for all Sprint 2 work, so it needs careful review; breaking changes bump the schema version.

nodes.label: V2-06-02 Age and life-stage in AmaniContext
nodes.norm_label: v2-06-02 age and life-stage in amanicontext
nodes.rationale: If only an age range exists it stays a range; an exact age is never fabricated.

nodes.label: V2-06-05 Symptom context
nodes.rationale: Symptom-lab connections are claims and need authority before they render; the unused symptomCorrelation.ts is revived only through this path.

nodes.label: V2-06-03 Medication context
nodes.rationale: Medication logging is not medication management (matches the Play health declaration), so no dose or schedule fields.

nodes.label: V2-06-04 Intervention context
nodes.rationale: Enables S2-07 and must stay descriptive ('after X, Y moved'), never causal.

nodes.label: V2-06-06 Historical biomarker series
nodes.rationale: Mis-merged series produce false trends, so unit mismatches are excluded or converted only with approved factors and lab ranges stay separate from catalog ranges.

nodes.label: V2-06-08 Wire AmaniContext into generation and insights, with data minimization
nodes.norm_label: v2-06-08 wire amanicontext into generation and insights, with data minimization
nodes.rationale: More context to the model means more PHI to a processor; any matching baseline exclusion in docs/check-functions.sh may be removed but never added.

nodes.label: S2-04 Doctor Visit / Doctor Mode
nodes.rationale: Shown to clinicians it edges toward clinical decision support, so it stays patient-owned and educational; export/share is a separate owner decision (none exists today).

nodes.label: Prescriptive-language checks
nodes.rationale: Banned prescriptive patterns enforced from _shared/nutrient-policy.ts; they may be extended (contraception/HRT changes, medication names) but never weakened.

nodes.label: No default clinical assumptions for unknown data
nodes.norm_label: no default clinical assumptions for unknown data
nodes.rationale: Unknown or missing data stays explicit and is never defaulted to a clinical assumption.

nodes.label: Explanatory-only context (never prescriptive or causal)
nodes.rationale: Medication, contraception/HRT and intervention context only explains patterns and never recommends changes or implies causation.

nodes.label: Model payload data minimization
nodes.rationale: Only whitelisted fields the task needs are sent to the model; the privacy disclosure draft is updated if the payload changes.

nodes.label: Journey step 3 (B): second included analysis, TSH 6 to 9
nodes.norm_label: journey step 3 (b): second included analysis, tsh 6 to 9

nodes.label: Journey step 4 (C): third included analysis and deep Plus anchor
nodes.norm_label: journey step 4 (c): third included analysis and deep plus anchor

nodes.label: React patterns (error boundaries on lazy routes, one context, memoize at expensive boundaries)
nodes.norm_label: react patterns (error boundaries on lazy routes, one context, memoize at expensive boundaries)

nodes.label: Routing and code-splitting (eager landing/auth, lazy /app/*, ProtectedRoute)
nodes.norm_label: routing and code-splitting (eager landing/auth, lazy /app/*, protectedroute)

nodes.label: N1-3 AndroidBackHandler root routes include /pricing, /success, /reset-password
nodes.rationale: Users deep-linked to those routes would otherwise navigate(-1) against empty history into a blank WebView.

nodes.label: P1-2 lazyWithRetry for chunk-load failures after deploys
nodes.norm_label: p1-2 lazywithretry for chunk-load failures after deploys
nodes.rationale: Users holding an old index.html hit 404ing hashed chunks after a deploy, worst in Capacitor webviews that persist across deploys.

nodes.label: Capacitor bridging discipline (never import @capacitor/* in components)
nodes.norm_label: capacitor bridging discipline (never import @capacitor/* in components)
nodes.rationale: New native capabilities go into src/lib/native.ts with a platform guard and a web fallback, otherwise the web build breaks; a new top-level route needs an explicit exit-on-back decision in AndroidBackHandler.

nodes.label: Capacitor native bridging through src/lib/native.ts
nodes.rationale: Every plugin call is guarded with Capacitor.isNativePlatform() and stubbed by src/lib/capacitor-stubs/ so the web build runs without a native runtime.

nodes.label: Gate order: UpdateGate > DeviceLockGate > AppRoutes, then consent and onboarding
nodes.norm_label: gate order: updategate > devicelockgate > approutes, then consent and onboarding
nodes.rationale: AndroidBackHandler checks the lock before navigating and exits while locked; the lock registers no exitAppOnBackButton, avoiding multiple back listeners navigating underneath it.

nodes.label: Trigger-owned profile creation (on_auth_user_created → handle_new_user)
nodes.rationale: SignupForm's unconditional profile INSERT conflicted (409) with the row the signup-transaction trigger already creates; the write was removed and onboarding still UPDATEs the row.

nodes.label: Supabase persistence with RLS as the security boundary
nodes.norm_label: supabase persistence with rls as the security boundary

nodes.label: App Store Connect setup (subscription group, products, metadata, keys, sandbox)
nodes.norm_label: app store connect setup (subscription group, products, metadata, keys, sandbox)

nodes.label: App Store Server Notifications V2 pointed at RevenueCat
nodes.norm_label: app store server notifications v2 pointed at revenuecat
nodes.rationale: Without it RevenueCat learns about renewals and refunds by polling, which is slower and can miss a refund.

nodes.label: RevenueCat 'default' offering ($rc_monthly, $rc_annual)

nodes.label: Declined Health Categories: Not a Medical Device, Not Clinical Decision Support
nodes.norm_label: declined health categories: not a medical device, not clinical decision support
nodes.rationale: Terms.tsx:81 disclaims device status and Amani has no regulatory clearance; CDS supports clinicians while Amani is direct-to-consumer and its nutrient policy architecturally prevents recommending a course of action. Condition, nutrition and medication management are also declined (no protocol, food log, dose or schedule), and Diseases and Conditions Management must be revisited once anything condition-specific ships.

nodes.label: Server-Side Nutrient Policy Enforcement Behind the Disclaimer
nodes.norm_label: server-side nutrient policy enforcement behind the disclaimer
nodes.rationale: The boundary is a validator run on every AI response, not a prompt promise: a nine-nutrient allow-list that fails closed on unlisted supplementation, a banned-supplement deny-list, and dosage, prescriptive-verb and frequency regexes. A violation triggers one stricter regeneration, then sanitizeViolations, and a null result serves the deterministic interpretation, so the user always gets a report and never unsafe text.

nodes.label: Per-string recursive validation (findTextViolations, validateInterpretationOutput)
nodes.rationale: Each freeform string is checked independently so a match cannot be assembled across two unrelated fields; violations are reported as code:match strings, deduplicated across the object.

nodes.label: sanitizeViolations null contract (fail-closed sanitization)
nodes.rationale: Only top-level string arrays (what_you_can_do_now, what_to_do_next, questions_for_doctor) lose violating items. Scalar and nested strings such as overall_interpretation carry the clinical content and cannot be partially edited, so any remaining violation returns null. This replaced returning the object unchanged, which had persisted a violation while the log claimed it was sanitized.
